d: Short, spiky platinum white hair is styled into two small high ponytails, featuring jagged bangs and a few deep crimson streaks. The golden yellow eyes are narrow and sharp, set on a face with a youthful, teenage appearance. A slender build is dressed in a white asymmetrical long-coat with red interior lining and red accents, worn over a white top and black torn tights that reach the waist. Signature details include a silver chain belt at the hip, white platform boots with black straps, and a large, ornate silver and black polearm.
